en.quote: There will be no additional call-up of reservists [for the operation in Ukraine].
en.head: A partial mobilization was later announced.
en.body: On September 21, 2022, Putin announced a partial mobilization, calling up reservists for the war in Ukraine. Defence Minister Sergei Shoigu said 300,000 people were called up. It was the kind of additional call-up of reservists addressed in the March statement.
